letter.heading: To the Girl Who Holds My Heart,
paragraphs: Happy Birthday! Today isn't just another date on the calendar — it's the day the sweetest, kindest, most radiant person came into this world.
Thank you for every laugh we've shared, every picture I get to keep like treasure, and every little moment where simply talking to you makes my whole day brighter.

I hope this year wraps you in gentle mornings, endless smiles, soft joy, and all the love you give so effortlessly to everyone around you. No matter where life takes us, I'll always be cheering the loudest for you.
letter.closing: Happy Birthday once again, cutie. I love you more than words can fit on a screen.
